outcome: SARS-CoV-2 transmission to fetus/newborn (via amniotic fluid, placenta, umbilical cord blood, breast milk)
finding: Pregnant women with COVID-19 had a higher risk of gestational hypertension, preterm birth, c-section, and mortality, but SARS-CoV-2 transmission to newborns was insignificant (5.4%) and not through breastfeeding.
mod_finding: Mothers with COVID-19 were significantly more likely to give birth prematurely by c-section compared to the general pregnant population.
